# Aliyun chatbot manage

Curated by Skill Harbor — @cinience's aliyun-chatbot-manage skill, listed here with credit to its creator: an operations guide for managing Alibaba Cloud Chatbot (Beebot) instances via the cloud console and APIs. 💳 Requires a billed Alibaba Cloud account — the skill manages your instances, it doesn't give you one; API calls and chatbot usage are metered by Alibaba Cloud. It covers creating and configuring bot instances, intent and dialogue-flow management, knowledge-base ingestion, testing and publishing workflows, and day-to-day operations (monitoring, versioning, rollback). Honest caveats: credentials are yours — AccessKey management happens through your own Alibaba Cloud RAM console and vault, never in the skill; the Alibaba Cloud chatbot product surface evolves fast, so verify endpoint and parameter names against the current official docs before scripting; console screenshots and console-first flows may drift. MIT licensed. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Discovered via skills.sh.
